faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BITS Pilani Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Research Assistant position at BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus is 20 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Assistant post in the BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus recruitment drive. This offers a focused opportunity for eligible candidates in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for BITS Pilani Research Assistant Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the BITS Pilani Research Assistant Vacancy 2026 is through Email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Assistant position at BITS Pilani?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant position at BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000 per month. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate degree in Geography, Urban Studies, Sociology, or allied disciplines. Specializations in Urban Geography, Urban Planning, or Urban Sociology are preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for BITS Pilani Research Assistant Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant position involves two main stages: shortlisting of applications based on eligibility criteria and qualifications, followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for BITS Pilani Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BITS Pilani Research Assistant Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Research Assistant position is Hyderabad, Telangana, specifically at the Birla Institute of Technology & Science, Pilani Hyderabad Campus. This offers an opportunity to work in a prominent educational institution.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this (permanent/contractual)?
faq.answer: This Research Assistant position at BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus is a Contract job. Candidates should be aware of the contractual nature of the employment before applying for the post.
